apiAccess.label: To what extent can third-party systems access solution data and functionality through documented APIs without vendor-specific development?

options: Mix of structured and unstructured data

options: Stored within the solution / solution-specific repository
Stored in an external archive controlled by the vendor

options: Emergency access / break-glass with audit trail
